description: Get the director and related-person (PDMR) transactions a regulator published for one listing outside the US, written MIC:TICKER (e.g. XSTO:VOLV-B). Coverage today is Sweden's Finansinspektionen register, matched by the issuer's LEI or the security's ISIN, so rows can include the issuer's other instruments. Each row gives the transaction date, the person and role, a related person where reported, the transaction type, the instrument and ISIN, volume, price and currency, and the source status including amendments. Only captured publication days are covered, and the register is not a complete insider-ownership record. For US Form 4 filings use GetInsiderTransactions.

ticker.description: Listing symbol MIC:TICKER, e.g. XSTO:VOLV-B; a provider suffix such as VOLV-B.ST also works. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's listings outside the US to ask with.
